scope: Strict TypeScript gateway route configuration and credential lookup with host environment getter, snapshot models/providers and live timeout/reasoning/key semantics
limits: No intentional runtime behavior changes in this extraction.
Model/provider lists are initialized once; credentials/timeouts/reasoning still read live settings. Changing a model at runtime retains the existing restart requirement.
Configurable future model/provider strings are not proof of wire/structured-tool capability or measured quality/cost/latency.
Existing strict/native/background route priorities, unsupported parallel flag, fallback aliases and finite-positive timeout policy remain unchanged.
Credential lookup preserves existing environment/quote/alias semantics and remains a host-only boundary; no actual keys are recorded in evidence.
Legacy adapter configuration type names remain available as projections of the actual typed configuration.
client.js transport, request/response parsing, trace IO, chain retries and request-payload.js remain subsequent migration units; the router remains unfinished.
Node 22 smoke uses three synthetic fetch responses in a network-disabled container; no live provider calls, real model metrics or full server boot.
No scheduler, SQL/storage/provider configuration/model choice/deployment/V2 activation or live WhatsApp effect changed; no new PostgreSQL fixture required.
